item.title: The Dissonance of Davos 2026: Capital Allocation in an Age of Fragmentation and the AI–Energy Nexus
item.description: The World Economic Forum’s 56th Annual Meeting opened beneath the banner of “A Spirit of Dialogue”. What emerged in Davos-Klosters was something sharper: a widening gap between political theatre and boardroom reality.
